calculatorChecks.name: Calculator is discoverable through home, search, navigation and stable favorites without identifiers
Calculator handles four operations, decimal precision, precedence, signs, correction and errors by touch
Calculator keyboard is scoped and accessible without intercepting search or browser shortcuts
Calculator touch targets, contrast and offline operation remain usable with blocked storage

limits: Chromium headless on Linux only; no physical iPhone/Android, Safari, VoiceOver, TalkBack or NVDA.
Production Cloudflare and a separate homologation deploy are not exercised by this local test.
No claim of full WCAG conformance or independent clinical/institutional validation.
Native browser zoom at200%/400% was not exercised; responsive viewport widths were checked.
Printer hardware, physical duplex orientation, folded paper and native mobile print dialogs were not exercised; CSS print rendering and supplied PDF imposition were checked.
